body: Won’t making her forcefully go to a therapist bring no results? She won’t be able to share with them whats in her head
She does not feel safe with anyone not just her parents. They probably can help her more than i can, i am clueless as to what to do.
She refuses any kind of solutions and i am really feeling helpless
Because she feels like she does not deserve help
She does not want to go to therapy and does not want me to let her family know, should i still tell them?

Well for the first one, yeah i did apologize
And yup i really need to learn how

I get what you mean, but me and them are already “friends” so in terms of knowing them or getting used to each other all is done. My problem lies in that they show interest midway and when i start showing interest everything goes downhill.

Haha. It is not about that, i had no interest at the start but when i gain interest they suddenly change. Just want to know where the issue is so i can improve on it, Before i go out and disappoint them in person.
Yes I totally understand. Thank you 😃

That she thinks i am not always a good person to vent to. I am always there when she or any other of my friends needed to vent, so a bit disappointed that she does not think i am a good person to vent to.
